raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "arrive"
  role subject "the electricity bill"
  role time "3 of the month"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "write"
  role subject "the bill"
  role object "the deadline 15/10"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "be open"
  role subject "the post office"
  role time "Tuesday and Thursday"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "pay without penalties"
    role subject "the user"
    role object "the bill"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
